developer_reply: Hey there, thanks for doing the questionnaire! Hypermonkey is completely free to use. We have a free trial when users first join but you can cancel it anytime after starting it. Once you cancel it, you will be using the free version of the app. Please feel free to reach out to us here: hello@tryhypermonkey.com if you have any other issues!
